question: The average of first 157 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Average** of the first **n even numbers** is simply given by the formula **(n + 1)**.

Given **n = 157**.

Average = 157 + 1 = 158.

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total even numbers (n) = 157.

**Formula Used:** Average of an Arithmetic Progression (AP) = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e34b2bfbb3bb913458de7046cb45b88aa3a0e4747e675774b428c1004efb24cb.png] 

⇒ First even number (a) = 2

⇒ 157th even number (l) = 2 × 157 = 314

⇒ Average = (2 + 314) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 316 ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 158

**∴ The correct answer is 158.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of first n even numbers

The total sum is calculated as Sₙ = n × (n + 1).

Average of first n odd numbers

The average of the first n odd numbers is simply equal to n.

Average of first n natural numbers

The average of the first n natural numbers (1, 2, 3...) is (n + 1) ÷ 2.</p
